title: FrontmatterGeminiMarkdown
description: Frontmatter shape for nodes classified as `markdown` by the Gemini Provider — the format-named generic fallback for any markdown file under a Gemini scope that does not match a more specific path (`.gemini/agents/`, `.gemini/skills/`). Includes `GEMINI.md` (Gemini CLI's project context file). Extends the spec's universal `frontmatter/base.schema.json` with no additional fields.
